name: Sugar Cookies
subtitle: Classic Houghton recipe
notes: Bonus tip: If you need to speed up the decorating process, thin the frosting with more milk or lemon and place in a shallow dish like a pie tin. Mix colors in with a toothpick, creating a marbled effect and dip cookies in face-first. Immediately place on a cooling rack to allow the extra icing to drip off the edges.

steps.title: Cream the shortening
steps.body: Cream until fluffy: **⅔ cup shortening**, **1½ cups sugar**, **2 eggs** and **1 tsp vanilla/almond/lemon flavoring**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix in **3½ cups flour**, **2½ tsp baking powder**, **½ tsp salt** and **4 tsp milk**.

steps.title: Chill the dough
steps.body: Chill dough, covered tight, for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Roll and cut
steps.body: Roll out ½ at a time, to ⅛–¼-inch thick, and cut into amazing shapes.

steps.title: Make the frosting
steps.body: For lemon frosting, blend **2–4 Tbsp softened butter** and **1 cup powdered sugar** until creamy. Add **⅛ cup milk** and about **¼ cup lemon juice**.

steps.title: Add more sugar
steps.body: Add another **3+ cups powdered sugar**, adding additional milk or lemon juice to taste and powdered sugar to make the consistency and quantity desired. Color and spread!
